---
title: "Reduction of Order Flowchart"
format: html
---

<style>
.flow-container {
  position: relative;
  height: 650px;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  font-family: sans-serif;
}

.node {
  padding: 15px 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  min-width: 200px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.node:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.step1 { background: #e3f2fd; border: 2px solid #1976d2; grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 1 / 2; }
.step2 { background: #fff3e0; border: 2px solid #fb8c00; grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 2 / 3; }
.step3 { background: #ede7f6; border: 2px solid #5e35b1; grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 3 / 4; }
.step4 { background: #e8f5e9; border: 2px solid #388e3c; grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 4 / 5; }

.side-left { background: #fce4ec; border: 2px solid #d81b60; grid-column: 1 / 2; grid-row: 4 / 5; }
.side-right { background: #e1f5fe; border: 2px solid #0288d1; grid-column: 3 / 4; grid-row: 4 / 5; }
</style>

<div class="flow-container">
  <div id="step1" class="node step1">Given one solution:<br>\( y_1 \)</div>
  <div id="step2" class="node step2">Assume:<br>\( y = y_1 \cdot u \)</div>
  <div id="step3" class="node step3">Find \( y' \), set \( w = u' \), then find \( w \)</div>
  <div id="step4" class="node step4">Solve for \( u \), then plug into:<br>\( y = y_1 \cdot u \)</div>

  <div id="left" class="node side-left">Alternative:<br>Use substitution method</div>
  <div id="right" class="node side-right">Or use direct formula:<br>\( y_2 = y_1 \cdot \left( \int \frac{e^{-\int P(x)\,dx}}{y_1^2} dx \right) \)</div>
</div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step1'),
      document.getElementById('step2'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', color: '#1976d2', path: 'straight' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step2'),
      document.getElementById('step3'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', color: '#fb8c00', path: 'straight' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step3'),
      document.getElementById('step4'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', color: '#5e35b1', path: 'straight' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step4'),
      document.getElementById('left'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', color: '#d81b60', path: 'arc' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step4'),
      document.getElementById('right'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', color: '#0288d1', path: 'arc' }
    );
  });
</script>
